anchors.description: Overall width of the white box trailer, measured along the top edge of its flat white end panel (between the panel's two visible top corners).
anchors.visible_evidence: The large bright white panel is the trailer's end face; its top-left corner (~84,446) and the top-right corner (~222,439) where the panel meets the adjacent side wall (with two windows) are both clearly visible, so the span is the trailer body width.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact make/model is not identifiable; European tandem-axle box trailers are typically 1.5-2.1 m wide. The pixel aspect of the end face (height ~1.3x width) suggests a slim body (~1.5-1.8 m wide), while the tandem axles suggest a heavier 1.8-2.1 m chassis; interval spans both.
